topic: Device data buffer location and monitoring
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on the technical setup of a device data buffer used for monitoring. It was confirmed that the buffer is intended to run and accumulate data on a single server (04), which resolves previous confusion regarding its supposed presence across multiple servers.

Concerns were raised about monitoring systems relying on this table, as errors were observed when it did not appear to be populated correctly on all expected nodes. It was clarified that the buffer's purpose is to accumulate data before batch insertion into a distributed table spread across shards.

It was also noted that if traffic increases significantly, connecting a second server for reception will be necessary.
decisions: The device data buffer should remain on a single dedicated server (04).
A second server connection will be added when traffic volume increases substantially.
action_items: Someone needs to ensure the ClickHouse target is correctly configured for the monitoring system.
Monitor the data flow and buffer population on the designated primary server (04).
